{{Quote|I should have done this many years ago, ''adi'ke. Ni kyr'tayl gai sa'ad''—Mereel, Jaing, Kom'rk, A'den, Prudii. There. It's formal, legal. You're my sons and heirs.|[[Kal Skirata]], adopting the six [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Null''-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] as his sons|<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
The '''''gai bal manda''''' was the name of the traditional adoption ritual in [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture.

When translated from the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], the expression meant "name and [[Soul/Legends|soul]]."

Comprised of a simple statement of intent, a prospective Mandalorian [[Parent/Legends|parent]] needed only to recite the phrase ''ni kyr'tayl gai sa'ad''—"I know your name as my child"—followed by the name of the individual to be adopted.<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref>

The tradition could be conducted on a singular basis, or toward a group of several individuals, and even in some cases, [[Death/Legends|posthumously]].<ref name="O66" />

Adoption via the ''gai bal manda'' and a dedication to the ''[[Resol'nare]]'', the six basic tenets of Mandalorian culture, was often considered all it took to make one a Mandalorian.<ref name="TMPaC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The custom of ''gai bal manda'' was first mentioned and described in the [[2006]] ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article, ''[[The Mandalorians: People and Culture]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="TMPaC" /> Later that year, the adoption custom made its first full appearance in a ''[[Star Wars]]'' work in Traviss' [[EBook|e-novella]], ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''.<ref name="APM">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref> The ''gai bal manda'' subsequently featured in Traviss' [[Republic Commando|''Republic'' and ''Imperial Commando'' series]] of novels,<ref name="O66" /> as well as her additions to the multi-[[Author/Legends|author]] series, ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]''.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>
